_note: Camp (docs/plans/rebuild-phase5-run.md, section 9; Decisions 8, 9, 13) and the day's nodes (phase 5c step 8, docs/plans/days-and-nodes.md; rebuild-phase5c-combos.md, section 16): each option has one job, and what it does is code (RunFlow); this file names them, says which places offer which, and gives their numbers. A camp shows `shown` options drawn from its place's menu. Camp is one of the day's nodes (`nodes`: their names, lines, and icons); the Magpie's node comes from magpie_from_day, at most magpie_per_act times an act. The Pedlar is the day's shop, and Rift Tear and the Magpie are nodes, so no place offers them. All numbers are first guesses. A Rift Tear (phase 5c step 8b) asks for a depth (`rift_depths`): every depth's enemies take rift_tear_mod, and Deep and Abyssal add rift modifiers (`rift_modifiers`, drawn for the day): each a kit mod on every enemy and summon kit (`mod`), on the heroes (`hero_mod`), a start for Rift Collapse (`collapse_from_ms`), or Reinforcements (`reinforcements`: that many of the encounter's first enemy that isn't its elite or boss join from the edge at `at_ms`). Winning that fight offers a relic of each of the depth's `relics` tiers.

nodes.name: Camp
nodes.text: Make camp somewhere the rift hasn't swallowed: one of its options.

nodes.name: Rift Tear
nodes.text: Tomorrow's enemies come through a tear, warded by the rift; win that fight for a relic choice.

nodes.name: The Magpie
nodes.text: He sells what he took from bands who fell in the rift: charms at rank II and a relic, cheap. One look. He buys relics, and swaps one a visit.

options.name: Train
options.text: An upgrade pick: one of three upgrades for your heroes.

options.name: Hunt
options.text: Fight a small pack right now for shards. Losing it doesn't count as a loss.

options.name: Rest
options.text: Clears every wound on the team.

options.name: Scout
options.text: See where the enemies of the next 2 days stand.

options.name: Map the Rift
options.text: Swap one of tomorrow's two fights for a different one.

options.name: Fortify
options.text: Your heroes start the next fight behind a small Shield.

options.name: Dig In
options.text: Place a rock in your zone for the next fight.

options.name: Shrine
options.text: A choice of two relics, each with a cost, or neither.

places.name: Waystone
places.text: A standing stone the rift hasn't swallowed yet.

places.name: Ruined Chapel
places.text: Half a roof, and something still kneeling at the altar.

places.name: Hunter's Blind
places.text: A blind of bone and hide, facing the dark.

places.name: Rift Scar
places.text: The ground here is torn, and it hums.

passives.name: Fortified
passives.text: Starts the fight behind a small Shield (Fortify, at camp).

passives.name: Rift-Warded
passives.text: Starts the fight behind a Shield of a tenth of its max HP (a Rift Tear).

rift_depths.name: Shallow
rift_depths.text: Tomorrow's enemies start behind a Shield of a tenth of their max HP. Win for a choice of 2 rare relics.

rift_depths.name: Deep
rift_depths.text: The Shield, and one rift modifier. Win for a choice of 2 epic relics.

rift_depths.name: Abyssal
rift_depths.text: The Shield, and two rift modifiers. Win for a choice of a legendary relic and an epic one.

rift_modifiers.name: Hardened
rift_modifiers.text: Tomorrow's enemies are harder to hurt.

rift_modifiers.name: Rift-Charged
rift_modifiers.text: Tomorrow's enemies start with their signature half charged.

rift_modifiers.name: Bloodthirst
rift_modifiers.text: Tomorrow's enemies heal by part of the damage they deal.

passives.name: Bloodthirst
passives.text: Heals by part of the damage it deals (a rift modifier).

rift_modifiers.name: Thornskin
rift_modifiers.text: Tomorrow's enemies send part of each hit back at whoever struck them.

passives.name: Thornskin
passives.text: Sends part of each hit it takes back at the attacker (a rift modifier).

rift_modifiers.name: Nightfall
rift_modifiers.text: Tomorrow's enemies start hidden, so nothing can pick them for the first moments.

passives.name: Nightfall
passives.text: Starts the fight hidden for a moment (a rift modifier).

rift_modifiers.name: Blood Frenzy
rift_modifiers.text: Each of tomorrow's enemies that falls makes the rest stronger.

passives.name: Blood Frenzy
passives.text: As it falls, its allies hit harder for the rest of the fight (a rift modifier).

rift_modifiers.name: Blight
rift_modifiers.text: Your heroes take less healing tomorrow.

rift_modifiers.name: Early Collapse
rift_modifiers.text: Tomorrow the rift starts closing in early.

rift_modifiers.name: Reinforcements
rift_modifiers.text: Tomorrow, two more of the enemies' kind join the fight from the edge.
